signalPath.title: Signal Path
signalPath.configured: Configured route · not a live measurement
signalPath.formatExplanation: The MPD status describes a reported decoded format, not the original codec or the signal received by the DAC. It does not verify Hi-Res, native DSD or bit-perfect playback.
signalPath.sharedExplanation: ALSA default follows system routing, which may involve PipeWire, PulseAudio or dmix, with possible mixing and conversion. The endpoint is not measured here.
signalPath.directExplanation: The configured ALSA endpoint bypasses the shared default route. This view does not confirm that the PCM is open, hardware format support, or absence of processing. Software volume and ReplayGain can modify PCM.

libraryDoctor.loading: Reading tags from this album’s files…

libraryDoctor.noFindings: No findings in the checks performed

codes.album_artist_absent: Album Artist not obtained from the read tag
codes.album_artist_empty: Empty Album Artist in the read tag
codes.track_exceeds_total: Track number exceeds the declared total
codes.disc_exceeds_total: Disc number exceeds the declared total
codes.possible_number_conflict: Repeated positive disc and track numbers
codes.cue_checks_not_performed: CUE present, without tag or numbering checks

checks.canonicalization_discarded_entries: Entries discarded when grouping the catalog

limits.membership: Inspection covers only tracks associated with this album by the current catalog. It does not search for missing tracks or entries discarded during that grouping.
limits.dates: Years are compared only in valid year, year-month or year-month-day dates. Different precision within the same year is not a divergence. Original text is preserved; an uninterpretable date is not an absent date.
limits.numbers: An unobtained number may mean a missing tag or a value that could not be interpreted. We do not assume disc 1 or missing tracks. Numbers are compared only with positive declared totals.
limits.conflicts: Repeated positive disc and track numbers are only a possible conflict. They do not prove duplicate files; the same track number on different discs is legitimate. File content is not compared.
limits.cue: CUE presence is reported, but its tags and numbering are not checked. Reading all physical files does not make CUE coverage complete.
limits.snapshot: This result reflects one read, not an atomic snapshot: files are read at different times and can change during inspection.
limits.invalidation: Closing this screen or invalidating the result discards replies in this interface. It does not cancel a file read that has already started.
